scope: Independent native U1 foreign-pad coverage of maximum one-mm rounded courtyard escape boundary; no routed copper
method: Native inward foreign pad polygon distances upper-bound true pad distance. Segment sampling is bounded by 1-Lipschitz distance with half pitch; two polygon-error reserves plus coordinate rounding are added. A covered closed maximum-escape boundary prevents even a zero-width continuous drain conductor from reaching exterior without violating a generic pair gap. Actual nonzero conductor width cannot improve this.
